about: A supervisor plans a school charity bake sale with a researcher, a writer and a critic; a treasurer is available but never called. All run on Anthropic.
how: The supervisor answers with JSON only and calls one worker at a time; every result returns to it, so its context grows with each turn.
learns: A supervisor sees everything, which is useful and expensive: every turn returns to it, and its context grows.
watch: How the supervisor passes each result into the next instruction, and that it is called five times for four steps of work.
